messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described close-up front-facing camera setup and movement. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She begins facing the camera, then raises both arms overhead and leans back in a stretching or dancing motion before returning to an upright, forward-facing pose.","camera":"Static medium close-up at eye level, centered on the subject.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top with dark straps at the shoulders.","hair_color":"Bright yellow.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair with bangs framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit dock or shipyard area with weathered wooden planks, a small boat, and stacked lumber in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a full-body wide shot to a static medium close-up centered on the woman's face and upper torso, matching the reference framing. Her yellow hair, pink top, dance/stretching motion, and dock scene remain consistent, with the same action progression and timing.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving identity, hair, clothing, expression, action, scene, and timing.
unexpected_changes: The white skirt and black boots are no longer visible due to the close-up framing.
